verdict: Leads are up and cost per lead is down; Google spend needs fixing.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 138 leads at $15.80 per lead, and the most recent week improved on both counts — leads grew 5.56% while cost per lead fell 2.67%. All 138 leads came through Meta on $1,672.27 in spend; Google Ads ran $508.73 over the same window and produced zero leads, which is a confirmed problem, not a fluctuation. We are reviewing Google Ads now to determine whether budget should be redirected or the campaign restructured before more spend is lost. Next period you should expect a clearer picture on Google and continued lead flow from Meta as scheduling is tightened.
